description: This file defines the IndexToLocationTable class in the PdfSharp.Fonts.OpenType namespace, which manages the reading, preparation, and writing of the 'loca' table in an OpenType font, specifically handling glyph location offsets.

classes.name: IndexToLocationTable
classes.description: Manages the glyph location offsets in an OpenType font, including reading from font data, preparing data for compilation, and writing back to font binary format.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads and interprets the 'loca' table data from the font, supporting both short and long index formats.

methods.name: PrepareForCompilation
methods.description: Prepares the 'loca' table data for binary serialization by calculating size and converting the offsets into byte arrays.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Serializes the 'loca' table data into the font writer for output.
